subtasks: Hold the pen holder with one hand, place all pens into it with the other hand, then put it back down.
Keep holding the orange holder with the right gripper. Pick up the loose cyan highlighter behind the holder with the left gripper and insert its flat barrel tail into the opening, capped end up.
Transfer support of the upright orange holder to the left hand, then use the right hand to pick up the loose cyan highlighter on the far right and insert it flat barrel tail down, cap up.
Leave the upright filled holder on the table, fully open both grippers, withdraw clear of the pens and return both arms directly to their initial poses.
